title: Declare and enforce the Rust minimum supported version
description:
## Problem

Kanbus 0.23.0 does not declare a Rust minimum in `rust/Cargo.toml` and the repository has no Rust toolchain file or user-facing build prerequisite. On Cargo 1.81.0, a normal build fails inside a transitive dependency because `clap_lex 1.1.0` requires Edition 2024 support.

## Reproduction

`cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --bin kbs`

Environment:

- Kanbus commit `3c5dec99` / version 0.23.0
- `rustc 1.81.0`
- `cargo 1.81.0`

Observed error:

`feature edition2024 is required` while parsing the downloaded `clap_lex 1.1.0` manifest.

## Expected behavior

Kanbus should define one supported Rust toolchain contract. Building with an older toolchain should fail immediately with an actionable version requirement rather than a transitive-manifest error.

## Acceptance criteria

- The repository declares the supported Rust version in the canonical Cargo metadata or a pinned toolchain file.
- Installation/build documentation states the same requirement.
- CI verifies the declared minimum or intentionally uses the pinned version.
- A build attempted with an older toolchain produces a clear actionable failure.
- Release tooling reports the selected Rust toolchain.
